set.body: Outcome: checked exact-grid composition from authoritative assignments; explicit reject/first/second overlap and reject/drop occlusion; deterministic fresh IDs, certified parent-to-output remaps, full both-parent provenance and exact first spatial owner. Scope: shared atlas composition and portable publication/metric codecs; no resampling, grouping, dilation, assets, new field or mapping algebra, or publication. Acceptance: canonical identity independent of source encoding and display order; conflicting spaces, shifted/anisotropic/permuted grids, overlap and complete occlusion, duplicate labels and large source IDs, both-parent evidence and metric roundtrip, JVM and JS suites, consumers and warning-clean compileAll. Initial design review requested from existing read-only expert. Evidence: /private/tmp/scalafim-atlas-compose-20261001/.
set.title: Atlas 5a: exact-grid two-parent composition
